items.title: XLM parity and threat model
items.blockedReason: XRC source supports XLM/USD and defaults to a received-rate floor of 3 and freshness up to 120 seconds, but live XLM quote/quorum is unknown. The read-only connector refused the backend for lack of a service-discoverability manifest; the direct XRC sample is a paid update and was not called.
items.nextAction: Verify connected-wallet CreateAccount and native Payment first-funding support; establish an authorized read-only path for XRC XLM/USD and independently validate provider endpoints when DNS access is available.

items.title: Claims, exits, and liquidation handling

items.nextAction: Compile/test claim reservation decisions, then implement and validate XLM claim settlement and supported payout lifecycle; preserve WP4 blocked until settlement and testnet evidence exists.
